# Analysis B: update structure and increments (auto-generated by `incr_summary.py`)

North of 30N only (bands N_30_45, N_45_60, N_60_90); all days of each snow year (1 Aug to 31 Jul) except the excluded days (33 days: input gaps and 2023-08-01) which are dropped from every arm. An increment is |sum of the 3 layer WESN increments| >= 0.01 kg m-2; cap = |incr| >= 4.995 kg m-2 (SCF_ANA_MAXINCRSWE 5). Tile-days are summed over days and tiles.
